modern: Hurry to examine your own ruling faculty and that of the universe and that of your neighbour: your own, so that you may make it just; that of the universe, so that you may remember what you are a part of; and that of your neighbour, so that you may know whether he has acted in ignorance or with knowledge, and may also consider that his ruling faculty is akin to yours.
original: Hasten [to examine] thy own ruling faculty and that of the universe and that of thy neighbor: thy own, that thou mayst make it just: and that of the universe, that thou mayst remember of what thou art a part; and that of thy neighbor, that thou mayst know whether he has acted ignorantly or with knowledge, and thou mayst also consider that his ruling faculty is akin to thine.
